history.summary: ISKCON (Gaudiya Vaishnava) temple at Gowthami Ghat beside Godavari Bund Road, Tyagaraja Nagar (533101). Deities Sri Sri Radha Gopinath with Dasavatara deities; the deity of Mother Godavari is offered pooja twice daily, Govinda Srinivas abhishekam on Fridays, and sannai vayidyam on Saturdays/Sundays. The centre runs mid-day meal and cow-protection activities and has a gift stall with Founder-Acharya books. Founding year not verified from a reliable source (one aggregator's '59 years' claim looks AI-generated and is not used) - flagged.

town_description: Rajamahendravaram (Rajahmundry), on the east bank of the Godavari in East Godavari district, is one of the oldest cities of Andhra Pradesh. It was the 11th-century seat of Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra and the birthplace of Telugu literature under the poet Nannaya. It is famed for its riverside ghats and Godavari Pushkarams, the Dowleswaram Barrage, paper mills and nurseries.

travel.road: Rajahmundry Bus Station - about 4 km; local buses and taxis

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Janmashtami and Ratha Yatra are the grandest occasions
